sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:151845
Court No. - 40
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 27340 of 2024

Applicant :- Ram Pravesh Prasad
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Bipin Kumar Tripathi,Shubham

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shekhar B. Saraf,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed by learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

By means of this bail application, applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.331 of 2023, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C. and Section 66-D of Information and Technology Act, 2008,
Police Station-Hapur Nagar, District Hapur, during pendency of trial.
4. It has been contended by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
It is further submitted that the applicant was not named in the first information report and his name has came into light during the course of investigation.
It is further submitted that as a matter of fact the applicant has neither received any money either in his account or in the account of his family members.

It is further submitted that the applicant is neither the beneficiary nor anyway directly or indirectly concerned in the entire episode of alleged cyber crime except the arrest and confession made before the police, there is no exclusive Ram Pravesh Prasad vs State Of U.P. on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84770652/
1 recovery either from the possession or on his pointing out and therefore there is no credible evidence against the applicant to connect him with the complicity of the alleged offence.

entities.text: Ram Pravesh Prasad vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the offence is triable by Magistrate.

It is further submitted that the applicant is the proprietor of Suraj Automobile, but he used to repair puncher of two wheeler and having no concern with any kind of cyber crime and in fact the mobile numbers of the petitioner and his daughter-in-law have been hacked and misused by some miscreants and the applicant has been made victim of the planned conspiracy.
Several other submissions in order to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against the applicant have also been placed forth before the Court.
The circumstances which, according to the counsel, led to the false implication of the accused has also been touched upon at length.
It has been assured on behalf of the applicant that he is ready to cooperate with the process of law and shall faithfully make himself available before the court whenever required.
It has also been submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 1.3.2023.
It has been pointed out that the applicant has criminal history which has been duly explained in paragraph nos.8, 9, 10 and 11 of the supplementary affidavit.

5. Furthermore, the co-accused namely Suraj Kumar has already been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 1.4.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.12218 of 2024, a copy of said order is annexed as annexure-1 to this bail application.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.12218 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant claims parity.
6. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid fact as argued by learned counsel for the applicant.

7. Keeping in view the aforementioned facts and circumstances, nature of the offence, provisions for release of accused on bail, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, and submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant Ram Pravesh Prasad involved in aforesaid case crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted and/ or the applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required.
iv.
The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

sentences.text: The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
vi. The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court.
vii. In the event, the applicant changes his residential address, the applicant shall inform the court concerned about new residential address in writing.
9. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

10. However, it is made clear that the observations made above may not be taken into consideration in any manner whatsoever by the learned Trial court while adjudicating or expediting the trial in the aforesaid case crime.
